newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson says pleased with court ruling.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson says pleased with court ruling.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson and Co said it was pleased with a Delaware Court's action Friday ordering Great Western Financial Corp to produce affidavits within three days justifying its action to delay its annual meeting.
"We are pleased that the court has rejected this attempt by Great Western to prevent a hearing on the conduct of the Great Western board," the company said in a release.
The ruling is an answer to a motion of Great Western to dismiss Ahmanson's claims Great Western acted improperly in moving its annual meeting to June 13.

"Ahmanson is pleased because the court has not granted Great Western's motion to quash its claims, which included one that said Great Western breached its fiduciary duty by not holding the meeting more promptly and also that Great Western violated its very own bi-laws in failing to hold the meeting more promptly," said a source near Ahmanson.
"We're also pleased because disovery will proceed on an accelerated basis."
Ahmanson said, however, that the court did dismiss one count of its complaint to the extent that it was asserted as the basis for premeeting injunctive relief.
